title: Figure 5: Distribution of Object Sightings by Evaluation Within Months for All Years
description: Stacked percentage bar chart with one bar per month from January to December, each split into hatched segments for Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloons, Insuf. info., Other and Unknown. The y-axis is "Per Cent of Each Months Object Sightings", and monthly totals are printed above the bars (e.g., 638 in July, 407 in August). Caption: "FIGURE 5 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY EVALUATION WITHIN MONTHS FOR ALL YEARS"; drawing A-7483.
